items: Remember that Alfred Wegener proposed the continental drift theory.
Identify convergent boundaries as the specific plate interactions that create mountains.
Note for density questions: Oceanic plates are denser than continental plates.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Alfred Wegener introduced the theory of continental drift.
Pangaea existed as a supercontinent around 300 million years ago.
Tectonic plates undergo continuous slow movement of a few centimeters per year.
Convergent boundaries are responsible for mountain formation.
Oceanic plates possess a higher density compared to continental crust.
The Ring of Fire harbors the majority of active volcanoes globally.
